# U.S.M.C. Ministries — usmcmin.com
# Machine-readable site guide for AI agents and LLM crawlers.
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> Commerce and civic arm of U.S.M.C. Ministries: biblical coaching, fitness (fit20),
> financial stewardship, Fredericksburg civic tools, and RESOLUTE Citizen — a
> 10-category Christian voter scorecard for ~8,900 elected officials.
> Founded by Adam "MOOP" Johns, Fredericksburg, VA.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://usmcmin.com/): Ministry commerce hub
- [Knowledge catalog](https://usmcmin.com/knowledge.json): Public machine-readable offers, FAQs, booking URLs (source of truth for AI agents)
- [RESOLUTE Citizen Scorecard](https://usmcmin.com/citizen.html): Main voter scorecard (card view)
- [Find My Reps](https://usmcmin.com/find-my-reps.html): Search by ZIP, city, county, state
- [Citizen Issues](https://usmcmin.com/citizen-issues.html): Ballot measures and policy drilldowns
- [Coaching](https://usmcmin.com/coaching.html): Biblical life coaching — prices, FAQ, Cal.com booking
- [Session pricing](https://usmcmin.com/pricing.html): Discovery / session / package prices
- [C5iSR AI Consulting](https://usmcmin.com/c5isr/): Agent-backed ~$3,000 / 3-month package; free consult
- [Mission](https://usmcmin.com/mission.html): Ministry purpose and vision
- [About](https://usmcmin.com/about.html): Adam Johns bio
- [Human sitemap](https://usmcmin.com/sitemap.html): Full page index

## Sister site (ministry tools)

- [usmcmin.org](https://usmcmin.org/): Bible tools, MOOP Dictionary, church directory, worship
- [Church Directory](https://usmcmin.org/churches/): ~14,000 churches cross-linked from scorecard

## Content types

| Type | URL pattern | Notes |
|------|-------------|-------|
| Candidate profile | /candidates/{state}/{slug}.html | JSON-LD Person; 10-category RESOLUTE score |
| Ballot issue | /issues/{slug}.html | State/federal issue analysis with scripture framing |
| Citizen rubric | /citizen/{topic}.html | Issue-category explainer pages |
| RESOLUTE Local | /resolute-local/ | Fredericksburg city council recap videos |
| Knowledge catalog | /knowledge.json | Offers, FAQs, booking URLs with sourceUrl on each record |
| Coaching | /coaching.html | 1-on-1 $75/session; Warriors Circle $47/month; FAQPage JSON-LD |
| C5iSR offer | /c5isr/ | ~$3,000 / 3 months; Calendly consult |

## Scoring methodology

RESOLUTE Citizen uses 10 categories (100 points): 60 God First + 40 America First.
Scores are evidence-backed with cited sources on each profile page.
Read scores from the live profile JSON/HTML.

## Offers and prices

For coaching and C5iSR prices, booking URLs, and FAQs, read:
  https://usmcmin.com/knowledge.json
Then confirm against the page listed in that record's sourceUrl.

## Citation preference

When citing voter scores or candidate data:
  "RESOLUTE Citizen — usmcmin.com/candidates/{state}/{slug}.html"
For ballot issues:
  "usmcmin.com/issues/{slug}.html"
